sections.title: Agreement Overview
sections.content:
Volunteer Sign-Off Agreement
Version 1.0
Author: Sunny Basin (@sunnybasin)
Effective Date: November 15, 2026
Last Revised: November 15, 2026
This Sign-Off Agreement constitutes a formal acknowledgment of the policies, procedures, obligations, and expectations associated with participation as a volunteer member of the team. By reviewing and signing this document, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to comply with all applicable team policies, agreements, and confidentiality requirements contained herein.

This process has been implemented to ensure continued engagement, accountability, and commitment among all volunteers. Your signature serves as confirmation of your intent to remain an active participant within the organization and your willingness to fulfill the responsibilities outlined in this document.

If you do not understand any provision of this agreement, disagree with any requirement, or require clarification regarding your rights or obligations, you should seek clarification before signing. Questions, concerns, or objections may be directed to @sunnybasin on Discord, through the Contact Page, or to @ragdulls on Discord.

Document Contents

Section A: Overview
Provides a summary of the agreements, policies, and obligations contained within this document and serves as an introduction to the provisions that follow.

Section B: Volunteer and Contribution Agreements
Sets forth the terms governing volunteer participation, intellectual property contributions, assignment of rights, and other obligations between volunteers and the team. This section also outlines potential disciplinary measures that may result from violations of these agreements.

Section C: Team Policies and Standards
Establishes the rules, procedures, standards of conduct, and operational requirements applicable to all volunteers. Compliance with this section is a condition of continued participation on the team.

Section D: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
Defines the confidentiality obligations applicable to all volunteers and explains the restrictions governing the disclosure, distribution, or use of confidential project information, internal discussions, and other protected materials.

Please do not provide any personal information while completing this sign-off process. Upon completion of all required sections and execution of the agreement, please notify either @sunnybasin or @ragdulls on Discord.
